title: Miband 4 - Bug Report: Screen Brightness
symptom: The screen goes dark for the watch face upload (as intended) but after that it stays dark for about 20s to 60s. It seems to switch back to day mode when the next full minute is reached.
cause: The phone can't wake up in time after the thread was sent to sleep during the 7-second delay before restoring screen brightness.
fix: The issue is solved in the build available at https://bigdigital.home.blog, and the fix is part of PR #1659 which is not merged yet.
evidence_quote: Indeed, seems that your phone can't "wakeup" in time after the thread was sent to sleep. I'll try to implement this delay in another way and share a test application again.
